tools.name: search_by_area
tools.description: Search WeDJ for event vendors (DJs, photographers, videographers, photo booths) serving a given city/area. Returns the featured (paid) listings plus additional free listings, up to 20 total, each with business name, city/state, star rating, review count, price range, and profile URL.

state.description: State name or 2-letter code, e.g. Georgia or GA
